I heard about Bubble from social media buzz on IG and loved to read about their attention to ingredients on their website. The price points seemed too good to be true though, but I thought I'd give this brand a try. Holy moly, this toner is awesome. It comes in an adorable bottle that looks like a pill, and the dispenser gives out fine mist instead of chunks of liquid like other brands I've tried. It does have a unique smell but it's a clean, fresh smell. You wouldn't confuse the smell with any other brand, which I think adds to the uniqueness of this product. Use this toner right after you get out of the shower, let it soak in and then follow up with the Bubble gel moisturizer and you will have smooth, hydrated skin that isn't overly oily or greasy (perfect for those of us with oily and combo skin).
My granddaughter loves all of your products. She has been using them for the last 5 months and her skin looks amazing.

I never before was used to the idea of toners before or including it into my skincare as my skincare routine was always exfoliates, cleansers, moisturizers and serums. it was til last year i gave into the idea and included my first toner into my skincare and loved it just as much. i love how Bubble has two different types of toners into their skincare line— a toner spray bottle and a liquid toner bottle for everyone's preference. i been using the Bounce Back toner spray since i first gotten it and i really do love how it sits on my skin. I use it as toner before adding my moisturizers and after to seal everything together as the last step. I also use the Bounce Back through out the day for a touch up and freshen up my skin again and notice my skin back glowy again when I feel my skin is dull and tired. also love how the Bounce Back is a spray which makes it ten times easier and faster to use and re apply. I definitely recommend!
